verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਸਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal birakh fal dhet jiau paakhaan maare sir karavat seh geh paar paar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tree laden with fruit drops fruit to the person who throws stone at it, then it bears the pain of a saw on its head and in the form of a raft or boat takes the iron saw across the river;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੋਰੀਅਤਿ ਸੀਪ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saagar mai kaadd mukh foreeat seep ko jiau dhet mukataahal avagiaa na beechaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as an oyster is taken out of the sea, is broken and it yields a pearl to the one who breaks it open and feels not the insult that it faces;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਨਤ ਹਨਤ ਘਨ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khanavaaraa khaan khanat hanat ghan maanik heeraa amol paraupakaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a labourer strives the ore in a mine with his shovel and pick-axe and the mine rewards him with precious stones and diamonds;

verses.gurmukhi: ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਊਖ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਤ ਕੋਲੂ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੬॥
verses.translit_en: uookh mai piuookh jiau paragaas hot koloo pachai avagun ke'ee gun saadhan kai dhuaar hai ||326||

en.bdb: Just as sweet nectar-like juice is extracted out by putting it through a crusher, so are the evil-doers treated with sympathy and welfare by the true and saintly persons when they come to them. (326)
